c_star_rule: c* = the first crossing: the largest grid point c_j with Delta >= 0 at every grid point <= c_j, plus the linear interpolation to c_(j+1) (report only); a later grid point with Delta >= 0 is reported as non-monotone, also when Delta(0) < 0 gives none; Delta >= 0 on the whole grid gives at least the grid maximum (L15 (5))

criterion.freeze_scope_rule: menu_m_b (default; REQ-17 'frozen choice per (menu, M, B) cell', DRAFT section 7.2, L15 (6) 'k per (cell, c_d/c0)'): one rule and one k per cell, chosen on the equal-weight average of the two conventions' per-replicate criteria (the draws are shared, so the pairing and the paired MC SE hold) and used under both conventions, so REF LQ32's 'both conventions agree' compares one policy; menu_m_b_convention (switch; the builder's first reading, verifier B-1): each convention chooses its own rule and k. The equal weight per convention is a builder reading for REQ-21 (h) and (k); the lead rules
criterion.g_rule: G(pick) = U(keep) - U(pick) in truth; keep scores 0; a truly infeasible pick scores 0 and is a violation (FOCUS 2 Oct convention)
criterion.k_rule: per (menu, M, B, c_d/c0) (freeze_scope): the diagnostic's k with the largest E[G(pick)], also averaged with equal weight over the main quality grid and the cost conventions (and over rho when rho_average_for_rule is true: W1-14 item 4, the rule and k by the same criterion); a tie goes to the larger k
criterion.rule: per (menu, M, B) cell (freeze_scope): the runs-only rule with the largest E[G(pick)], equal weight per (shape, size) grid point, per tau_O point and per cost convention, at sigma central and on the equal-weight average over rho in {0, 0.67} (A7 with rho_average_for_rule; LN-10); a tie (the paired difference below 2 Monte Carlo SE under common random numbers) goes to the simpler rule (one_shot, halving, bisection)

definitions.Delta: E[G(diagnostic pick)] - E[G(runs-only pick)] at the same total budget, c_d paid out of B
definitions.G: G_m = U(a0) - U(m) (keep G = 0); on planted menus keep = a0_plant
definitions.P_best: P(the pick's true G equals the replicate's V); a truly infeasible pick is never best
definitions.V_max: E[max over the truly feasible options and keep of G]

intervals.rule: parameter uncertainty: the minimum and maximum over the prior's (shape, size) grid points at sigma central, rho 0; the sensitivity cases (sigma high, the 2x option, rho 0.67) beside them; the runs-only predictions at rho 0.67 beside them (runs_only.by_rho); every mean carries its Monte Carlo SE
